description: C++20 idioms, RAII smart pointers, competitive programming fast I/O, Disjoint Set Union (DSU), and CMake/GCC build commands.
ai_rules: Adhere strictly to RAII: avoid manual delete calls and prefer std::unique_ptr and std::make_unique for dynamic memory.
Pass read-only non-trivial types by const reference (const T&) and primitive scalars by value.
Enable compiler warnings (-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic) and treat undefined behavior with extreme caution.
